description: real/face-based-surface-model's three faces at the origin corner of the 40 × 30 × 10 box, with face #237's bound #238 written with its sense turned (.T. for .F.) and its surface and same_sense kept: the face walks both edges it shares with its neighbours the way they do, as Open CASCADE's writer writes a face reversed on a left-handed surface frame.
